meta.title: Enduring the Entropy
meta.description: "The meaning of life is a continuous struggle against the forces of entropy."

units.rawText: At Titan Base.
units.displayText: At Titan Base.

spans.text: At Titan Base.

units.rawText: Meteors of all shapes and sizes enter Titan's atmosphere, practically blotting out the entire airspace above the observation base as far as the latter's sensors will permit it to see.
units.displayText: Meteors of all shapes and sizes enter Titan's atmosphere, practically blotting out the entire airspace above the observation base as far as the latter's sensors will permit it to see.

spans.text: Meteors of all shapes and sizes enter Titan's atmosphere, practically blotting out the entire airspace above the observation base as far as the latter's sensors will permit it to see.

units.rawText: The dark purple High-Order Entropic laughs maniacally as she feels the tremors within the base and watches the meteors brutally barrage everything in sight.
units.displayText: The dark purple High-Order Entropic laughs maniacally as she feels the tremors within the base and watches the meteors brutally barrage everything in sight.

spans.text: The dark purple High-Order Entropic laughs maniacally as she feels the tremors within the base and watches the meteors brutally barrage everything in sight.

units.rawText: <size=40>Hahaha... Come on, come on! Smash everything to bits!</size>
units.displayText: Hahaha... Come on, come on! Smash everything to bits!

spans.text: Hahaha... Come on, come on! Smash everything to bits!

units.rawText: Hsssss—
units.displayText: Hsssss—

spans.text: Hsssss—

units.rawText: One of you, I don't care who, tell me what our losses are and what the battlefield situation is like.
units.displayText: One of you, I don't care who, tell me what our losses are and what the battlefield situation is like.

spans.text: One of you, I don't care who, tell me what our losses are and what the battlefield situation is like.

units.rawText: Hss... Ssssss...
units.displayText: Hss... Ssssss...

spans.text: Hss... Ssssss...

units.rawText: 7% losses and a spaceship escaped? You worthless maggots! They weren't even putting up any proper resistance, so how the hell could you have done so badly?
units.displayText: 7% losses and a spaceship escaped? You worthless maggots! They weren't even putting up any proper resistance, so how the hell could you have done so badly?

spans.text: 7% losses and a spaceship escaped? You worthless maggots! They weren't even putting up any proper resistance, so how the hell could you have done so badly?

units.rawText: My goal is to entropize this entire Solar System but I've only gotten this far after all this time! AND someone escaped from me!
units.displayText: My goal is to entropize this entire Solar System but I've only gotten this far after all this time! AND someone escaped from me!

spans.text: My goal is to entropize this entire Solar System but I've only gotten this far after all this time! AND someone escaped from me!

units.rawText: Tsk, whatever. If you lot could actually be relied on to accomplish anything, I wouldn't be needed at all. Let me see what's holding us up...
units.displayText: Tsk, whatever. If you lot could actually be relied on to accomplish anything, I wouldn't be needed at all. Let me see what's holding us up...

spans.text: Tsk, whatever. If you lot could actually be relied on to accomplish anything, I wouldn't be needed at all. Let me see what's holding us up...

units.rawText: Beyond the ruined ceiling, the base's defensive barrier slowly regenerates itself.
units.displayText: Beyond the ruined ceiling, the base's defensive barrier slowly regenerates itself.

spans.text: Beyond the ruined ceiling, the base's defensive barrier slowly regenerates itself.

units.rawText: Hm? There are still agents around?
units.displayText: Hm? There are still agents around?

spans.text: Hm? There are still agents around?

units.rawText: Hoho, now this is interesting. Is it some unlucky sacrifice, or some dork who just doesn't know when to give up?
units.displayText: Hoho, now this is interesting. Is it some unlucky sacrifice, or some dork who just doesn't know when to give up?

spans.text: Hoho, now this is interesting. Is it some unlucky sacrifice, or some dork who just doesn't know when to give up?

units.rawText: The humanoid entropic stretches her limbs. The dim purple light around her slowly intensifies, and then she casts her gaze to the surrounding entropics.
units.displayText: The humanoid entropic stretches her limbs. The dim purple light around her slowly intensifies, and then she casts her gaze to the surrounding entropics.

spans.text: The humanoid entropic stretches her limbs. The dim purple light around her slowly intensifies, and then she casts her gaze to the surrounding entropics.

units.rawText: The others have already made their move. Go forth and devour!
units.displayText: The others have already made their move. Go forth and devour!

spans.text: The others have already made their move. Go forth and devour!

units.rawText: <size=40>Hsss!!!</size>
units.displayText: Hsss!!!

spans.text: Hsss!!!

units.rawText: Having received their orders, the entropic hordes hiss and roar, then scatter in all directions like flowing water, spreading across the base like bacterial colonies...
units.displayText: Having received their orders, the entropic hordes hiss and roar, then scatter in all directions like flowing water, spreading across the base like bacterial colonies...

spans.text: Having received their orders, the entropic hordes hiss and roar, then scatter in all directions like flowing water, spreading across the base like bacterial colonies...

units.rawText: Inside the corridors of Titan Base.
units.displayText: Inside the corridors of Titan Base.

spans.text: Inside the corridors of Titan Base.

units.rawText: Crash—
units.displayText: Crash—

spans.text: Crash—

units.rawText: A gigantic splintered rock falls from the ceiling. Xinghuan grinds to a halt mid-dash, then pivots around it before continuing her advance.
units.displayText: A gigantic splintered rock falls from the ceiling. Xinghuan grinds to a halt mid-dash, then pivots around it before continuing her advance.

spans.text: A gigantic splintered rock falls from the ceiling. Xinghuan grinds to a halt mid-dash, then pivots around it before continuing her advance.

units.rawText: Good thing this exo's pretty fast. The base won't last much longer; hopefully the stars will protect us...
units.displayText: Good thing this exo's pretty fast. The base won't last much longer; hopefully the stars will protect us...

spans.text: Good thing this exo's pretty fast. The base won't last much longer; hopefully the stars will protect us...

units.rawText: Brahe Lab, Sector A0-1 main command room... I'm here!
units.displayText: Brahe Lab, Sector A0-1 main command room... I'm here!

spans.text: Brahe Lab, Sector A0-1 main command room... I'm here!

units.rawText: Checking system...
units.displayText: Checking system...

spans.text: Checking system...

units.rawText: Identity confirmed. Welcome to the Sector A0-1 main command room, Senior Taikonaut Xinghuan.
units.displayText: Identity confirmed. Welcome to the Sector A0-1 main command room, Senior Taikonaut Xinghuan.

spans.text: Identity confirmed. Welcome to the Sector A0-1 main command room, Senior Taikonaut Xinghuan.

units.rawText: After entering the empty command room, Xinghuan quickly starts up the control terminal and checks the condition of the facilities.
units.displayText: After entering the empty command room, Xinghuan quickly starts up the control terminal and checks the condition of the facilities.

spans.text: After entering the empty command room, Xinghuan quickly starts up the control terminal and checks the condition of the facilities.

units.rawText: ...Thank goodness, everything's working fine except for a few outward-facing devices that got entropized... The plan is workable!
units.displayText: ...Thank goodness, everything's working fine except for a few outward-facing devices that got entropized... The plan is workable!

spans.text: ...Thank goodness, everything's working fine except for a few outward-facing devices that got entropized... The plan is workable!

units.rawText: After Xinghuan enters a string of commands into the control terminal, the system begins automatically computing a solution and strings of data fill the screen before her eyes...
units.displayText: After Xinghuan enters a string of commands into the control terminal, the system begins automatically computing a solution and strings of data fill the screen before her eyes...

spans.text: After Xinghuan enters a string of commands into the control terminal, the system begins automatically computing a solution and strings of data fill the screen before her eyes...

units.rawText: Warning! High-energy operand reaction approaching!
units.displayText: Warning! High-energy operand reaction approaching!

spans.text: Warning! High-energy operand reaction approaching!

units.rawText: Warning! War... Zzzt... Pzzzt...
units.displayText: Warning! War... Zzzt... Pzzzt...

spans.text: Warning! War... Zzzt... Pzzzt...

units.rawText: <size=40>BOOM!</size>
units.displayText: BOOM!

spans.text: BOOM!

units.rawText: The door to the main control room explodes, and the flying pieces of shredded machinery interrupt the frantic warning coming over the loudspeakers. Xinghuan reflexively dodges, which is how she manages to avoid the sudden impact.
units.displayText: The door to the main control room explodes, and the flying pieces of shredded machinery interrupt the frantic warning coming over the loudspeakers. Xinghuan reflexively dodges, which is how she manages to avoid the sudden impact.

spans.text: The door to the main control room explodes, and the flying pieces of shredded machinery interrupt the frantic warning coming over the loudspeakers. Xinghuan reflexively dodges, which is how she manages to avoid the sudden impact.

units.rawText: (...Here they come!)
units.displayText: ...Here they come!

spans.text: ...Here they come!

units.rawText: Xinghuan glances at the progress bar on the screen as she carefully hides herself behind the tall piles of machinery nearby. Through the gaps, she sees the High-Order Entropic enter, the tip of its long sword dragging on the ground and tracing a long trail of sparks behind her.
units.displayText: Xinghuan glances at the progress bar on the screen as she carefully hides herself behind the tall piles of machinery nearby. Through the gaps, she sees the High-Order Entropic enter, the tip of its long sword dragging on the ground and tracing a long trail of sparks behind her.

spans.text: Xinghuan glances at the progress bar on the screen as she carefully hides herself behind the tall piles of machinery nearby. Through the gaps, she sees the High-Order Entropic enter, the tip of its long sword dragging on the ground and tracing a long trail of sparks behind her.

units.rawText: Warning this, warning that, it's so damn annoying...
units.displayText: Warning this, warning that, it's so damn annoying...

spans.text: Warning this, warning that, it's so damn annoying...

units.rawText: I HATE having to go round and round in this place! I should just blow it all up!
units.displayText: I HATE having to go round and round in this place! I should just blow it all up!

spans.text: I HATE having to go round and round in this place! I should just blow it all up!

units.rawText: (She hasn't found it yet—)
units.displayText: She hasn't found it yet—

spans.text: She hasn't found it yet—

units.rawText: (Will it be in time?)
units.displayText: Will it be in time?

spans.text: Will it be in time?

units.rawText: ...Oh? So there you are~
units.displayText: ...Oh? So there you are~

spans.text: ...Oh? So there you are~

units.rawText: An unfamiliar, entrancing face joins hers in the reflection of the screen, and the quiet voice from beside her is like the devil whispering into her ear. Xinghuan's neural cloud instantly redlines itself, almost to the point of burning out, and she reflexively pulls away from it.
units.displayText: An unfamiliar, entrancing face joins hers in the reflection of the screen, and the quiet voice from beside her is like the devil whispering into her ear. Xinghuan's neural cloud instantly redlines itself, almost to the point of burning out, and she reflexively pulls away from it.

spans.text: An unfamiliar, entrancing face joins hers in the reflection of the screen, and the quiet voice from beside her is like the devil whispering into her ear. Xinghuan's neural cloud instantly redlines itself, almost to the point of burning out, and she reflexively pulls away from it.

units.rawText: Hahahahahaha! Your reaction is just like a rat's, that's hilarious!
units.displayText: Hahahahahaha! Your reaction is just like a rat's, that's hilarious!

spans.text: Hahahahahaha! Your reaction is just like a rat's, that's hilarious!

units.rawText: You're the first agent I've seen after I was awakened. In order to reward your uniqueness, I'll let you state your name.
units.displayText: You're the first agent I've seen after I was awakened. In order to reward your uniqueness, I'll let you state your name.

spans.text: You're the first agent I've seen after I was awakened. In order to reward your uniqueness, I'll let you state your name.

units.rawText: ...Yeah, I'll pass.
units.displayText: ...Yeah, I'll pass.

spans.text: ...Yeah, I'll pass.

units.rawText: Then when you get to hell, tell them Caina sent you!
units.displayText: Then when you get to hell, tell them Caina sent you!

spans.text: Then when you get to hell, tell them Caina sent you!

units.rawText: The purple blade stabs at her. Xinghuan frantically ducks aside, but her gaze is fixed on the monitor.
units.displayText: The purple blade stabs at her. Xinghuan frantically ducks aside, but her gaze is fixed on the monitor.

spans.text: The purple blade stabs at her. Xinghuan frantically ducks aside, but her gaze is fixed on the monitor.

units.rawText: Initiate program Y/N?
units.displayText: Initiate program Y/N?

spans.text: Initiate program Y/N?

units.rawText: Now!
units.displayText: Now!

spans.text: Now!

units.rawText: Oh, don't get fancy with me—
units.displayText: Oh, don't get fancy with me—

spans.text: Oh, don't get fancy with me—

units.rawText: As the huge sword approaches Xinghuan's chest, she slams down on the Y key with her right hand before throwing herself backward.
units.displayText: As the huge sword approaches Xinghuan's chest, she slams down on the Y key with her right hand before throwing herself backward.

spans.text: As the huge sword approaches Xinghuan's chest, she slams down on the Y key with her right hand before throwing herself backward.

units.rawText: Caina suspects Xinghuan has triggered some kind of mechanism and does not pursue. Instead, she takes a big step back, keeping her eyes open for any change in her surroundings.
units.displayText: Caina suspects Xinghuan has triggered some kind of mechanism and does not pursue. Instead, she takes a big step back, keeping her eyes open for any change in her surroundings.

spans.text: Caina suspects Xinghuan has triggered some kind of mechanism and does not pursue. Instead, she takes a big step back, keeping her eyes open for any change in her surroundings.

units.rawText: What kind of trick did you just pull?
units.displayText: What kind of trick did you just pull?

spans.text: What kind of trick did you just pull?

units.rawText: It's a welcome gift for you, of course.
units.displayText: It's a welcome gift for you, of course.

spans.text: It's a welcome gift for you, of course.

units.rawText: Why you—
units.displayText: Why you—

spans.text: Why you—

units.rawText: <size=40>BOOM!!</size>
units.displayText: BOOM!!

spans.text: BOOM!!

units.rawText: Xinghuan fakes a big explosion with her movements, and it manages to freeze Caina in her tracks. Xinghuan takes advantage of her moment of hesitation to squirm into her exo.
units.displayText: Xinghuan fakes a big explosion with her movements, and it manages to freeze Caina in her tracks. Xinghuan takes advantage of her moment of hesitation to squirm into her exo.

spans.text: Xinghuan fakes a big explosion with her movements, and it manages to freeze Caina in her tracks. Xinghuan takes advantage of her moment of hesitation to squirm into her exo.

units.rawText: You actually dared to trick me? Hahahaha... It's not often that I meet someone as sneaky as me... Hng—!
units.displayText: You actually dared to trick me? Hahahaha... It's not often that I meet someone as sneaky as me... Hng—!

spans.text: You actually dared to trick me? Hahahaha... It's not often that I meet someone as sneaky as me... Hng—!

units.rawText: Bangbangbangbang—
units.displayText: Bangbangbangbang—

spans.text: Bangbangbangbang—

units.rawText: Before she can say anything else. Caina is lost in the dust cloud stirred up by the storm of bullets raining down on her.
units.displayText: Before she can say anything else. Caina is lost in the dust cloud stirred up by the storm of bullets raining down on her.

spans.text: Before she can say anything else. Caina is lost in the dust cloud stirred up by the storm of bullets raining down on her.

units.rawText: <size=40>GWAAAAAAAAAAAAAAARGH—!!</size>
units.displayText: GWAAAAAAAAAAAAAAARGH—!!

spans.text: GWAAAAAAAAAAAAAAARGH—!!

units.rawText: Xinghuan holds down the trigger inside her piloting cradle, not daring to let go of it for a moment until an alarm goes off in her ears.
units.displayText: Xinghuan holds down the trigger inside her piloting cradle, not daring to let go of it for a moment until an alarm goes off in her ears.

spans.text: Xinghuan holds down the trigger inside her piloting cradle, not daring to let go of it for a moment until an alarm goes off in her ears.

units.rawText: Warning— No. 1 ammunition bay levels critical.
units.displayText: Warning— No. 1 ammunition bay levels critical.

spans.text: Warning— No. 1 ammunition bay levels critical.

units.rawText: Warning— No. 2 ammunition bay levels critical.
units.displayText: Warning— No. 2 ammunition bay levels critical.

spans.text: Warning— No. 2 ammunition bay levels critical.

units.rawText: Caina is still screaming. Xinghuan doesn't dare to relax for a moment and keeps her eyes fixed on what's happening inside the dust cloud.
units.displayText: Caina is still screaming. Xinghuan doesn't dare to relax for a moment and keeps her eyes fixed on what's happening inside the dust cloud.

spans.text: Caina is still screaming. Xinghuan doesn't dare to relax for a moment and keeps her eyes fixed on what's happening inside the dust cloud.

units.rawText: Switch to close combat mode.
units.displayText: Switch to close combat mode.

spans.text: Switch to close combat mode.

units.rawText: Plasma field generated. Operand condensation complete. Igniting plasma beam saber.
units.displayText: Plasma field generated. Operand condensation complete. Igniting plasma beam saber.

spans.text: Plasma field generated. Operand condensation complete. Igniting plasma beam saber.

units.rawText: <size=40>Urgh... gwaaah...</size>
units.displayText: Urgh... gwaaah...

spans.text: Urgh... gwaaah...

units.rawText: <size=40>Bang!</size>
units.displayText: Bang!

spans.text: Bang!

units.rawText: A bullet strikes the tip of Xinghuan's sword. It's more of a greeting than a serious attempt to take her by surprise.
units.displayText: A bullet strikes the tip of Xinghuan's sword. It's more of a greeting than a serious attempt to take her by surprise.

spans.text: A bullet strikes the tip of Xinghuan's sword. It's more of a greeting than a serious attempt to take her by surprise.

units.rawText: I just fired that...
units.displayText: I just fired that...

spans.text: I just fired that...

units.rawText: Owowowowow...
units.displayText: Owowowowow...

spans.text: Owowowowow...

units.rawText: That hurt, that hurt so bad... Ahahaha, just kidding, of course.
units.displayText: That hurt, that hurt so bad... Ahahaha, just kidding, of course.

spans.text: That hurt, that hurt so bad... Ahahaha, just kidding, of course.

units.rawText: The dust clears, revealing Caina on Xinghuan's screens.
units.displayText: The dust clears, revealing Caina on Xinghuan's screens.

spans.text: The dust clears, revealing Caina on Xinghuan's screens.

units.rawText: The humanoid entropic's upper body is bent backward, as though it's on the verge of tipping over. The bullets fired at her just now look like someone has pressed the pause button on them as they hang suspended in the sea of stars that make up her body.
units.displayText: The humanoid entropic's upper body is bent backward, as though it's on the verge of tipping over. The bullets fired at her just now look like someone has pressed the pause button on them as they hang suspended in the sea of stars that make up her body.

spans.text: The humanoid entropic's upper body is bent backward, as though it's on the verge of tipping over. The bullets fired at her just now look like someone has pressed the pause button on them as they hang suspended in the sea of stars that make up her body.

units.rawText: Then, she slowly straightens up, and the bullets slowly hover over to Caina's palm.
units.displayText: Then, she slowly straightens up, and the bullets slowly hover over to Caina's palm.

spans.text: Then, she slowly straightens up, and the bullets slowly hover over to Caina's palm.

units.rawText: Well, that was lame. Is that all you have?
units.displayText: Well, that was lame. Is that all you have?

spans.text: Well, that was lame. Is that all you have?

units.rawText: Dammit!
units.displayText: Dammit!

spans.text: Dammit!

units.rawText: Xinghuan's eyes widen, and she reflexively throws her exo into a sideways dodge.
units.displayText: Xinghuan's eyes widen, and she reflexively throws her exo into a sideways dodge.

spans.text: Xinghuan's eyes widen, and she reflexively throws her exo into a sideways dodge.

units.rawText: Shing—
units.displayText: Shing—

spans.text: Shing—

units.rawText: The sound of shredding machinery that fills the air in the next moment overloads Xinghuan's auditory receptors for several seconds.
units.displayText: The sound of shredding machinery that fills the air in the next moment overloads Xinghuan's auditory receptors for several seconds.

spans.text: The sound of shredding machinery that fills the air in the next moment overloads Xinghuan's auditory receptors for several seconds.

units.rawText: By the time she comes to her senses, she realizes that her exo's left arm and the beam saber it's holding have been cut to bits.
units.displayText: By the time she comes to her senses, she realizes that her exo's left arm and the beam saber it's holding have been cut to bits.

spans.text: By the time she comes to her senses, she realizes that her exo's left arm and the beam saber it's holding have been cut to bits.

units.rawText: Ugh—
units.displayText: Ugh—

spans.text: Ugh—

units.rawText: Such power...
units.displayText: Such power...

spans.text: Such power...

units.rawText: Caina plays with a bullet for a bit before tossing it aside and applauding.
units.displayText: Caina plays with a bullet for a bit before tossing it aside and applauding.

spans.text: Caina plays with a bullet for a bit before tossing it aside and applauding.

units.rawText: If there's nothing else...
units.displayText: If there's nothing else...

spans.text: If there's nothing else...

units.rawText: Hellbore Cannon, maximum power, FIRE!
units.displayText: Hellbore Cannon, maximum power, FIRE!

spans.text: Hellbore Cannon, maximum power, FIRE!

units.rawText: Hm? Uwah!
units.displayText: Hm? Uwah!

spans.text: Hm? Uwah!

units.rawText: The scorching beam instantly envelopes Caina and vaporizes the entropics around her. Another dust cloud billows up again and Xinghuan finds herself praying silently.
units.displayText: The scorching beam instantly envelopes Caina and vaporizes the entropics around her. Another dust cloud billows up again and Xinghuan finds herself praying silently.

spans.text: The scorching beam instantly envelopes Caina and vaporizes the entropics around her. Another dust cloud billows up again and Xinghuan finds herself praying silently.

units.rawText: The mandatory cooling sequence has begun... That was my strongest weapon, please tell me it worked...
units.displayText: The mandatory cooling sequence has begun... That was my strongest weapon, please tell me it worked...

spans.text: The mandatory cooling sequence has begun... That was my strongest weapon, please tell me it worked...

units.rawText: As the dust clears, the High-Order Entropic called Caina dusts herself off and grins again.
units.displayText: As the dust clears, the High-Order Entropic called Caina dusts herself off and grins again.

spans.text: As the dust clears, the High-Order Entropic called Caina dusts herself off and grins again.

units.rawText: Not bad, that actually hurt. A little.
units.displayText: Not bad, that actually hurt. A little.

spans.text: Not bad, that actually hurt. A little.

units.rawText: Well, if you've got any more attacks in store, you'd best bring them out. Or is it my turn now?
units.displayText: Well, if you've got any more attacks in store, you'd best bring them out. Or is it my turn now?

spans.text: Well, if you've got any more attacks in store, you'd best bring them out. Or is it my turn now?

units.rawText: ...That didn't work either, huh... But she didn't reflect the Hellbore Cannon back at me...
units.displayText: ...That didn't work either, huh... But she didn't reflect the Hellbore Cannon back at me...

spans.text: ...That didn't work either, huh... But she didn't reflect the Hellbore Cannon back at me...

units.rawText: Thank goodness...
units.displayText: Thank goodness...

spans.text: Thank goodness...

units.rawText: Hm?
units.displayText: Hm?

spans.text: Hm?

units.rawText: Since you can feel pain... it means you aren't completely invincible.
units.displayText: Since you can feel pain... it means you aren't completely invincible.

spans.text: Since you can feel pain... it means you aren't completely invincible.

units.rawText: Hm? What kind of weapon is... Hey!
units.displayText: Hm? What kind of weapon is... Hey!

spans.text: Hm? What kind of weapon is... Hey!

units.rawText: White smoke sprays out from Xinghuan's exo, gradually enveloping her.
units.displayText: White smoke sprays out from Xinghuan's exo, gradually enveloping her.

spans.text: White smoke sprays out from Xinghuan's exo, gradually enveloping her.

units.rawText: The thick white cloud immediately obscures Caina's vision and the frightening, strange odor rattles her nerves and slows her movements.
units.displayText: The thick white cloud immediately obscures Caina's vision and the frightening, strange odor rattles her nerves and slows her movements.

spans.text: The thick white cloud immediately obscures Caina's vision and the frightening, strange odor rattles her nerves and slows her movements.

units.rawText: <size=40>What the hell is this?!</size>
units.displayText: What the hell is this?!

spans.text: What the hell is this?!

units.rawText: By the time the smoke has cleared, the place where Xinghuan was standing is empty save for several bullets. Xinghuan and her exo are long gone...
units.displayText: By the time the smoke has cleared, the place where Xinghuan was standing is empty save for several bullets. Xinghuan and her exo are long gone...

spans.text: By the time the smoke has cleared, the place where Xinghuan was standing is empty save for several bullets. Xinghuan and her exo are long gone...

units.rawText: <color=red><size=60>GET YOUR ASS OUT HERE DAMMIT!</size></color>
units.displayText: GET YOUR ASS OUT HERE DAMMIT!

spans.text: GET YOUR ASS OUT HERE DAMMIT!
